+2.0% day-over-day move (z-score 2.35) on 2019-11-14. Reasons given by 4 reports from that day:
- "Oil up 1 % on U . S . crude stocks fall , OPEC comments on U . S . shale growth" (lfpress.com, 2019-11-14). Reported move: up 1%. Reason: U.S. crude stocks fall. Quote: "Oil up 1 % on U . S . crude stocks fall , OPEC comments on U . S . shale growth" (source: 8afff5b56e9e3dc6)
- "UPDATE 4 - Oil up 1 % on U . S . crude stocks fall , OPEC comments on U . S . shale growth" (cnbc.com, 2019-11-14). Reported move: up 1%. Reason: U.S. crude stocks fall. Quote: "UPDATE 4 - Oil up 1 % on U . S . crude stocks fall , OPEC comments on U . S . shale growth" (source: 4e204a69975d6d2f)
- "Oil up 1 % on US crude stocks fall , OPEC comments on shale growth" (tribune.com.pk, 2019-11-14). Reported move: up 1%. Reason: US crude stocks fall. Quote: "Oil up 1 % on US crude stocks fall , OPEC comments on shale growth" (source: 5a6204b6057a5e8d)
- Untitled article (vanguardngr.com, 2019-11-14). Reported move: up 0.6%. Reason: surprise drop in U.S. crude inventories. Quote: "surprise drop in U.S. crude inventories" (source: 0d78b4bec6c19a7c)
Pointing the other way, 2 reports from that day:
- "WTI looks to settle below $57 after EIA report shows record crude production in US" (forexcrunch.com, 2019-11-14). Reported move: down 0.6%. Reason: record crude production in US. Quote: "WTI looks to settle below $57 after EIA report shows record crude production in US" (source: 527623ea0e72a58a)
- "Oil Prices Fall On Bearish EIA Inventory Report" (oilprice.com, 2019-11-14). Reported move: down, size not stated. Reason: crude oil inventory increase. Quote: "after the Energy Information Administration reported a crude oil inventory increase" (source: 6c584f07908cef6c)
